manifest.notes: Independent Saturnia fresh-input replication of the fixed R* v3 source. The sample is a third 32-pair census matching the source's exact 25-cell joint profile: 16 per form, 8 reports and 8 instructions per form, fixed ACTION/PATH/HOLDER word lengths, optional-slot combinations, windows and costs. Every ACTION and both complete arms are checked against all recoverable token banks on this revision and its predecessor. No-undo rows destroy a sole recoverable object or release information beyond the writer's reach. Every can-undo path restores the complete immediately preceding state; restoring a queue/channel setting does not claim to recover elapsed work or missed notifications. Costs are hypothetical case facts. Saturnia's second and earlier predecessor-version token work are disclosed involvement, not delegation, an adoption vote, or a reason to tune the result. This is one fixed English rendering, not shortest-English efficiency and not comprehension evidence.
